Behavior(Object object)

Registers a behavior and accepts a parameter of the Object type.

Parameter

Object object

Definition Field Type Mandatory or Not Description
properties Object Map No External properties of the component, which form a map between property names and property settings.
data Object No Internal data of the component, which is used together with properties to render the template of the component.
methods Object No Component methods, including event response functions and any custom methods. For the use of event response functions, see Events and Communication Between Components.
behaviors String Array No Inter-component code reuse mechanism similar to mixins and traits. For details, see behaviors.
created Function No Component lifecycle function executed when a component instance is created. Note that setData cannot be called in this function.
attached Function No Component lifecycle function executed when a component instance enters the page node tree.
ready Function No Component lifecycle function executed when the component layout is completed.
moved Function No Component lifecycle function executed when a component instance is moved to another node in the node tree.
detached Function No Component lifecycle function executed when a component instance is removed from the page node tree.

Sample Code

// my-behavior.js
module.exports = Behavior({
  behaviors: [],
  properties: {
    myBehaviorProperty: {
      type: String
    }
  },
  data: {
    myBehaviorData: {}
  },
  attached: function(){},
  methods: {
    myBehaviorMethod: function(){}
  }
})
